 Subscribe KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 21 — National top women’s doubles pair Pearly Tan-M. Thinaah advanced to the semi-finals of the Hong Kong Open 2026 after defeating American combination Lauren Lam-Allison Quynh Lee in the quarter-finals at the Kai Tak Arena yesterday.
 The second seeds needed just 37 minutes to secure a convincing 21-18, 21-11 victory over their opponents to book their place in the last four of the Badminton World Federation (BWF) World Tour Super 500 tournament.
 Pearly-Thinaah will next face fellow Malaysians Low Zi Yu-Noraqilah Maisarah Ramdan in an all-Malaysian semi-final clash tomorrow.
 Low-Noraqilah secured their semi-final berth after overcoming Francesca Corbett-Jennie Gai of the United States 21-19, 16-21, 21-16 in another quarter-final encounter.
 Meanwhile, in the men’s doubles, national pair Man Wei Chong-Tee Kai Wun also advanced to the semi-finals after defeating Denmark’s Daniel Lundgaard-Mads Vestergaard 21-16, 21-16.
 The eighth seeds will next face fifth-seeded Indian combination Satwiksairaj Rankireddy-Chirag Shetty, who defeated China’s Hu Ke Yuan-Lin Xiang Yi 21-13, 21-16. — Bernama
